plan.history: rev 4 (bf30ba3c...) built first; rev 6/7 replace the extraction rule (A5-1 on measured full-coverage profiles, A6-1 completion rows, R6-002 frozen rev-4 exception) and the A1 identity checks (A6-2, R6-001)

rules.pools: PRIMARY = archived records (data/hamiltonian/raw) + the production plan records; DIAGNOSTIC = the M4d extraction-check plan records. M5 selects from PRIMARY only; DIAGNOSTIC records enter only epsilon_grid on their overlap and are reported alongside (they never enter M6/M7, and never enter epsilon_cross, which feeds epsilon_spec).
rules.point_selection: M5: per (order, lambda) the largest-N PRIMARY record; ties at the same N: the production grid family (oversample 4, radius_cost 4.5) first, then larger mixed, tail and collapsed cutoffs; same configuration on several sites = one replica (Expanse representative), cross-site difference recorded.

auxiliary.mixed_selection: M1: mixed_sequence.extrapolate fits with >= 3 powers and Nmin >= Nmix/2; limit = median; half-spread = (max - min)/2; prefix check = same rule on the first Nmix/2 entries (Nmin >= Nmix/4)
auxiliary.eps_mix: |t| * max(selected mixed half-spread, |prefix limit - limit|), t = ct/lambda + c_th*lambda
auxiliary.eps_coll: |h(collapsed 400000 inputs: two_point and A_face(8192)) - h(800000 inputs)|
auxiliary.eps_tailcut: |h(A_face at tail 2048, 800000 norms) - h(A_face at tail 8192, 800000 norms)|; a conservative one-step estimate of the residual tail-cutoff error at 8192
auxiliary.sources: production records supply their own two_point 800000, mixed 16384 and sidecar A_face 8192; the c2aux job supplies them for archived-only (order, lambda) and supplies every 400000 and tail-2048 variant; one aligned set per (order, lambda) is used for every record of that (order, lambda), so cross-N comparisons differ only in the spectral part

spectral.columns: as analyze_extended.py: 1, (n/N)^-p, exp(-lam (n-nmin)) (n/N)^(r-1-j), exp(-2 lam (n-nmin)) (n/N)^(2r+3/4-j), j < e; column-normalised; numpy lstsq rcond=1e-13
spectral.fitted_quantity: h_n + A_face n^(-7/4) with the aligned A_face
spectral.selected: 3 or 4 power terms, e in {1, 2}, nmin in {5N//8, 3N//4} (8 fits; = 240/288 at N=384, 160/192 at N=256)
spectral.guards: a fit is accepted only with full numerical rank (singular values of the column-normalised design > 1e-13 s_max) and >= 2 residual degrees of freedom; rejected selected fits are reported and excluded
spectral.estimate: h(lambda) = median of the accepted selected fits; half-spread = (max - min)/2
spectral.influence: v = intercept row of pinv(design, rcond=1e-13) / column scale: limit = sum_n v_n y_n

validation.prefix: M4a: N' in {round(N/2), round(2N/3), round(3N/4), N}, same fractional windows of N'; drift = max - min over N'; epsilon_spec uses |h(N) - h(round(3N/4))|
validation.cross_N: M4b: every retained record of the same (order, lambda), aligned auxiliary inputs; epsilon_cross = max over LOWER-N PRIMARY records with lambda*N >= the order minimum of |h(max N) - h(lower N)|; diagnostic records are compared and reported but do not enter epsilon_cross
validation.eps_grid: M4d, rev 6/7 (A5-1, A6-1): delta_n = raw chain of the primary record - raw chain of a DIAGNOSTIC record of the same (order, lambda) with N_check >= N (a different Cauchy grid), SIGNED, at every n <= N (full coverage). On each accepted selected M3 window W: s = least-squares cubic in x = (n - mean_W n)/(max_W n - min_W n), rho = delta - s; value = |sum_W v_n s_n| + sum_W |v_n| |rho_n|; epsilon_grid = max over the selected fits and over ALL full-coverage comparisons of the point. Reported, not in E: the rev-4 L1 max sum_W |v_n| |delta_n| (superseded), the plain signed shift max |sum_W v_n delta_n| and max_W |rho_n|. The archived N=256 vs N=384 overlap is a full-coverage comparison for the N=256 records (reported; those records are not primary); the partial N=384 overlap is reported and never used. No transport, inheritance or continuation. A point without a full-coverage comparison (failed completion row) reuses its FROZEN rev-4 epsilon_grid and provenance from evidence/rev4/continuum_points.json, is flagged "extraction comparison missing: rev-4 exception", and the estimate is labelled "extraction coverage incomplete" (R6-002). A grid difference measures extraction sensitivity; it does not bound an error that both grids share.
validation.eps_round: M4e: r_n = |Xchain_n| 2^-52 sqrt(n) + |con| 2^-52; max over accepted selected fits of sum_n |v_n| r_n

regulator.sensitivity_term_set_role: enumerated with the others: it can be admissible and then enters epsilon_model
regulator.fit: numpy lstsq on [1, basis...] (rcond=None, as final_analysis.py); influence row w = pinv(B)[0] (/epsilon_spec when weighted)
regulator.underdetermined: fits with more parameters than points are not attempted (as final_analysis.py)

admissible.residual: max |residual| <= 3 * the largest epsilon_spec in the window
admissible.condition: np.linalg.cond of the design as fitted

regulator.fallback: if the preferred fit is not admissible: the admissible fit with the fewest parameters, then the most points, then unweighted, then the smaller condition number; result marked "preferred rejected"
regulator.deduplication: fits are deduplicated by (set of point identities, term set, weighting) before anything is counted; window labels selecting the same points are kept as metadata
regulator.validation: an order with fewer than 3 distinct admissible fits is "insufficiently validated" and excluded
regulator.eps_model: max over admissible fits of |h0_fit - h0(S_r)|
regulator.propagation: every per-order epsilon is sum_i |w_i| epsilon_i with the influence row w of S_r (L1, no averaging)
regulator.E_r: eps_prop + eps_mix + eps_coll + eps_grid + eps_round + eps_tailcut + eps_model (linear sum)

joint.model: shared h0, per-order coefficients; each retained order with its S_r (term set, points, weighting)
joint.acceptance: every order block has n_r - |T_r| - 1 >= 2, the residual rule per block (max |res| <= 3 * largest epsilon_spec of the block), condition < 1e8
joint.propagation: the same components through the h0 row of the joint pseudo-inverse (L1; shared systematics are never averaged down: worst-case signs)
joint.variants: the same alternative term set for every order x the same window variant (by index: all, drop1, drop2, cut1, cut2, cut3) x weighting; deduplicated by (per-order point sets, term set, weighting)
joint.eps_model_joint: max over admissible joint variants of |h0_variant - h0_joint|

rules.consistency: orders r, r' retained: consistent iff |h0_r - h0_r'| <= E_r + E_r' for every pair
outcome_table: 1: no retained order -> no estimate ("insufficiently validated")
2: one retained order -> h0_r +- E_r ("single order, not cross-validated")
3: >= 2 retained, not consistent -> envelope [min(h0_r - E_r), max(h0_r + E_r)] as midpoint +- half-width ("orders inconsistent")
4: >= 2 retained, consistent, joint accepted with >= 3 distinct admissible joint variants -> h0_joint +- E_joint
5: >= 2 retained, consistent, joint rejected or < 3 distinct admissible variants -> envelope as in 3 ("orders consistent, joint fit not validated")
rules.conversion: C2 = -pi^2/(4 b0) + h0/b0^2, mpmath 50 digits, b0 = 9 pi^2/8 (Gamma(3/4)/Gamma(1/4))^2; Delta C2 = Delta h0 / b0^2
rules.status: numerical diagnostics, not rigorous bounds; no proposed closed form is used anywhere
